main_text.p: pfenning / oder vier loth. Quadrans, drey pfenning/ oder sechs loth. Triens, vier pfenning oder acht loth. Quincunx, fünff pfenning/oder zehen loth. Semissis, sechs pfenning/oder zwölff loth. Septunx, siben pfen-ning/ oder vierzehe loth. Bes vel bessis, acht pfenning oder sechs zehen loth. Dodrans, neun pfenning/oder achtzehe loth. Dextrans seu decunx, zehen pfenning/ oder zwentzig loth. Deunx, eilff pfenning/ oder zwey vnd zweintzig loth. As vel assis, ein schilling oder vier vnd zwentzig loth.
main_text.head: Quid est Semiuncia?
main_text.p: Semiuncia vel semūcia est uncia dimidia, ein loth.
main_text.head: Quid est Sescunx?
main_text.p: Sescunx vel sescuncia est uncia & semiuncia, drey loth.
main_text.head: Quot rebus attribuitur As?
main_text.p: Septem rebus: pecuniæ, libræ, pedi, zodiaco, ju-gero, hæreditati, usurae. Hæres ex asse, alles guts ein Erbe. Usura ex sextante est, cum centenarius binos parit, wen hundert zween wucher. Sic usura ex qua-drante, triente, quincunce, semisse, &c. von hundert drey/vier/fünff/sechs/&c.
main_text.head: Observatio notatu digna.
main_text.p: Sæpe à Regulis Generalibus Speciales in singulis Declinationibus traditæ impediuntur: ut, Prophe-ta, etiamsi desinat in a, non tamen est generis fœmi-nini, sed masculini: Quia Generalis Regula est, Quæ viro, aut rebus viri specie conceptis congruunt, sunt masculini generis. Sic Venus, Veneris, die Göttin der Buler / etiamsi desinat in us, & u in obliquis mutet, non tamen est generis neutrius, sed fœminini: Quia generalis regula est, Quæ mulieri, aut rebus mulieris specie conceptis congruunt, sunt fœminini generis.

page.notes: Black letter (Fraktur) is used for the German words throughout; marked with bl. "Buler" (line 'die Göttin der Buler') is doubtful, read as printed. "drey" and "vier" in the coin list are read from a worn fraktur setting. The last word of the "von hundert" line ("&c.") is doubtful; it may be an abbreviation of "etc." in another form. The initial word "Sæpe à" has "à" read with some doubt. The page has no margin notes.
